                    # arm above. A complete cycle is skipped on resume; a cycle
                    # that is not the from-stage target is skipped until the
                    # target is reached.
                    if $resume_mode && [[ -z "$skip_until_stage" ]]; then
                        local _du_cyc_status

                            ".stage_statuses[\"$_safe_cyc_id\"]" '' 2>/dev/null || true)"
                        if [[ "$_du_cyc_status" == "complete" ]]; then
                            # DSRHYD-2 / fail-closed (#1805): verify each cycle member's

                            local _dc_stages_var="_TPL_CYCLE_STAGES_${_dc_safe}"
                            local _dc_csv="${!_dc_stages_var:-}"

                                echo "error: resume: cycle '$_cyc_id' is marked complete but its stage list is empty — cannot verify artifacts; aborting" >&2

                            fi
                            local _dc_m _dc_plugin_dir _dc_manifest \
                                  _dc_prim _dc_resolved
                            IFS=',' read -ra _dc_members <<< "$_dc_csv"
                            for _dc_m in "${_dc_members[@]}"; do
                                [[ -z "$_dc_m" ]] && continue
                                _dc_plugin_dir=""; _dc_manifest=""; _dc_prim=""; _dc_resolved=""

                                    "$_dc_m" "$plugins_root" 2>/dev/null || true)"

                                    "$_dc_manifest" 2>/dev/null || true
                                [[ -z "$_dc_prim" ]] && continue
                                _verdict_resolve_path_v _dc_resolved \
                                    "$_dc_prim" "$state_dir"

                                    || _dc_resolved=""

                                    eb_emit_event \
                                        "stage.verdict.stale_artifact" \
                                        "stage=$_dc_m" "cycle=$_cyc_id" \
                                        "path=$_dc_resolved" \
                                        "run_id=$_runner_run_id"

                    local _cyc_stages_csv=""
                    local _cyc_safe="${_cyc_id//-/_}"
                    local _cyc_stages_var="_TPL_CYCLE_STAGES_${_cyc_safe}"
                    local _cyc_max_var="_TPL_CYCLE_MAX_${_cyc_safe}"
                    _cyc_stages_csv="${!_cyc_stages_var:-}"
                    local _cyc_max="${!_cyc_max_var:-?}"
                    # #831: pass the optional operator-facing description so
                    # the banner can include it (renderer no-op when empty).
                    local _cyc_desc_var="_TPL_CYCLE_DESCRIPTION_${_cyc_safe}"
                    local _cyc_desc="${!_cyc_desc_var:-}"
                    _render_cycle_entry "$_cyc_id" "$_cyc_max" "$_cyc_stages_csv" "$_cyc_desc"
                    # #698 (Wave 16-A) → Wave 19-B (#718): publish the cycle's
                    # seq-prefix (= its pipeline-cardinal at top level) so the
                    # orchestrator can render N-level member labels via
                    # recursive prefix accumulation
                    # ("<prefix>.<iter>.<position>"). Single-cycle templates
                    # bottom out at 3 segments (prefix=cardinal). Nested cycles

                    # cycle-as-member branch). Unset after the call so the var

#   status=interrupted                        → auto_resume
#   status=aborted                            → manual_resume_only
#   status=complete  (or missing)             → fresh_start
get_resume_recommendation() {
    local state_file="$1"

    if [[ ! -f "$state_file" ]]; then
        echo "fresh_start"
        return 0
    fi

    local status updated_at
    status="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.status' '')"
    updated_at="$(get_state_field "$state_file" '.updated_at' '')"

    case "$status" in
        complete|"")
            echo "fresh_start"
            ;;
        aborted|timed_out)
            echo "manual_resume_only"
            ;;
        interrupted)
            echo "auto_resume"
            ;;

            if [[ -z "$updated_at" ]]; then
                echo "manual_resume_only"
                return 0
            fi
            local updated_epoch now_epoch age_seconds
            updated_epoch="$(_zbuild_iso8601_to_epoch "$updated_at")"
            now_epoch="$(date -u +%s)"
            age_seconds=$(( now_epoch - updated_epoch ))
            if [[ $age_seconds -lt 86400 ]]; then
                echo "auto_resume"
            else
                echo "manual_resume_only"
            fi
            ;;
        *)
            echo "fresh_start"
            ;;
    esac
